about: OpenVPN config lines read as OpenVPN reads them (tokens), configs the sanitizer accepts (with the text it returns) or refuses (with every violation), and the verb level it reads.

sanitize.name: a typical client config passes unchanged
sanitize.config:
# Acme VPN
client
dev tun
proto udp
remote vpn.example.com 1194
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
remote-cert-tls server
auth-user-pass
script-security 1
setenv FORWARD_COMPATIBLE 1
setenv opt block-outside-dns
verb 3
<ca>
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIBszCCAVmgAwIBAgIUJ
up /tmp/not-a-directive-inside-a-block
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
</ca>
key-direction 1
<tls-auth>
-----BEGIN OpenVPN Static key V1-----
0123456789abcdef
-----END OpenVPN Static key V1-----
</tls-auth>

setenv IV_GUI_VER Acme
setenv-safe X 1
sanitize.output:

setenv IV_GUI_VER Acme
setenv-safe X 1

sanitize.name: a closing quote ends the token: options "u" and pl""ugin are not forbidden ones
a lone CR is whitespace: up is an argument of remote
not blocks (OpenVPN rejects them as unknown options)
accepted escapes
sanitize.config:
remote vpn\ example.com 1194
verify-x509-name "CN=Acme \"VPN\"" name
verify-x509-name 'C:\vpn\x' name
remote vpn\\.example.com
remote vpn.example.com\
remote \"vpn" 1194
sanitize.output:

verify-x509-name "CN=Acme \"VPN\"" name

sanitize.name: setenv opt with an allowed option
refused: mode without a value, or with more than p2p
a server config: the mode, the server's TLS role and its hooks are refused
sanitize.config:
mode server
tls-server
dev tun
port 1194
--Client-CRResponse "/tmp/x y"

sanitize.name: server modes inside a connection block and behind setenv opt
sanitize.config:
<connection>
remote vpn.example.com
setenv opt --mode server
TLS-SERVER
</connection>
setenv opt client-crresponse /tmp/x
<server>
x
</server>

sanitize.name: mode p2p and device names stay
sanitize.config:
mode p2p
MODE 'p2p'
dev tun
dev tap0
dev utun
dev null
dev tun-work
dev tap_lab
dev-type tap
sanitize.output:
mode p2p
MODE 'p2p'
dev tun
dev tap0
dev utun
dev null
dev tun-work
dev tap_lab
dev-type tap

sanitize.name: refused: a device name that is a path or another device
sanitize.config:
dev ../private/tmp/x1
dev tap/../../x1
dev disk2
dev TUN0
dev "tun 0"
dev tun.1
dev
<dev>
tun0
</dev>
setenv opt dev bpf0
